text:
Theo - Product: @channel quick heads-up: we're publishing the "Private Support Access & Minimal Telemetry" guidance for Private/VPC/on-prem customers. Effective 2026-11-15. Goal: clarify what level of remote assistance we offer, reduce default telemetry footprint, and provide a predictable path for customers who want either hands-on help or strict data isolation. TL;DR and action list below. :loudspeaker:

Mira - Eng-Security: can you summarize the changes vs today?

Theo - Product: short: 1) default telemetry for new private clusters = OFF; customers explicitly opt in at provisioning or later. 2) Support access levels defined (Support-Assist, Remote-Debug-ReadOnly, Full-Remote) with clear preconditions (attestation, consent, opt-in). 3) A documented, auditable consent flow for any log retrieval or ephemeral shell access. 4) A lightweight attestation option for customers that can't run vendor-signed images (signed nonce exchange via customer HSM).

Al - Support: will customers be denied remote help if they opt out? need to know for playbooks.

Theo - Product: no; tiered support: Support-Assist (phone + guided steps) remains available without telemetry. Full-Remote access requires customer opt-in and attestation per the table below. We'll publish a matrix in the KB.

Mira - Eng-Security: recommended tech controls: COSE-signed attestations for vendor images, mutual-TLS for ephemeral HSM attestation, and short-lived signed tokens for any support session. Audit events must capture requester, consent timestamp, and scope.

Priya - Legal: we'll need a short consent snippet for the portal and a new line in the contract addendum for assisted remote debugging. I'll draft a minimal consent form that we can show inline at provisioning and again before any support session.

Nina - Sales: flagging packaging: field wants a checkbox on the order form to capture support preference and a small fee option for Full-Remote SLA.

deploy-bot: feature flag "private.support_access_v2" enabled in staging at 2026-09-10T15:22Z.

ops-bot: telemetry default set: OFF for new private clusters. Metric created: private.telemetry.optin_pct.

Theo - Product: Support access matrix (short):
```
- Support-Assist: default, telemetry OFF. Customer gets phone/email support, guided checklists, and scripts. No log pull or shell by Redwood.
- Remote-Debug-ReadOnly: customer opts in to limited telemetry (logs only), attestation OR admin consent required. Redwood can pull logs and run read-only diagnostics.
- Full-Remote: customer opts in to telemetry + vendor-signed image OR HSM attestation; explicit session consent required for shell access; session is recorded and auditable.
```

Al - Support: action items we need from Eng/Security to make this usable: automated consent UI, short-lived grant tokens, and a one-click log-collection flow that customers can review before granting.

Mira - Eng-Security: ack. I'll own the attestation spec and the token service. Deliverables and dates below.

Theo - Product: Full action list (owners + dates):
```
- Eng-Security (Mira) -> attestation spec, short-lived support token service, audit-event schema -> due 2026-10-01
- Eng (Support infra + Al) -> one-click log collection flow + session recording toggle + UI consent prompt -> due 2026-10-15
- Legal (Priya) -> consent language, contract addendum, privacy checklist -> due 2026-09-20
- Sales (Nina) -> order-form checkbox + pricing SKU suggestion + enablement doc -> due 2026-09-30
- Product (Theo) -> KB, support matrix, and comms plan -> due 2026-09-18
```

Nina - Sales: can we get a short bullet for quoting?

Theo - Product: quick quote blurb: "Optional Full-Remote Support: Enabled by customer opt-in and attestation. Adds recorded remote debugging sessions and extended SLA. Contact your rep for pricing."

Al - Support: we'll prepare runbooks for each tier and a script for obtaining consent. Also will add fallback instructions for customers refusing telemetry.

Mira - Eng-Security: note on export control: HSM attestation workflows will vary by country; we'll make the HSM path opt-in and surface a list of restricted countries in the KB.

Priya - Legal: also recommending retention caps for any support session recordings (default 30 days) and a customer override opt-in for longer retention.

Theo - Product: rollout plan: internal enablement week of 2026-09-20, pilot with 5 high-touch customers in Oct, general availability 2026-11-15. We'll send customer notices 60 days prior to GA.

deploy-bot: staged rollout scheduled: pilot flag "private.support_pilot_5cust" set for Oct 2026.

Theo - Product: please file any follow-ups in #private-product-sync and tag me for blockers. Thanks team 44d
